int binarySearchCount(const vector<int>& arr, int n, int key) {
    int left = 0;
    int right = n - 1;
    int count = 0;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (right + left) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= key) {
            count = mid + 1;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
